services.name: Learn To Sail
services.desc: From casting off and crew, to Captain and cocktails, we’re ready! Charter our sailboat and sail along the the sound with breathtaking views, history, sunsets and more. We will take care of it all, from playing music (when requested), to finding great spots to swim, the best views and docking the boat. Your only job is to relax and enjoy. Looking for the ultimate private boat charter experience? Look no further than our premium boat rental services. Our sailboat charters, boat cruises, and sunset dinner cruises are perfect for any occasion. Explore the stunning coastal views, enjoy the sun-kissed breeze, and make unforgettable memories with your loved ones. With a range of vessels available,

The boats accommodate up to 6 passengers each, or up to 12 when chartering both boats. Activities include sailing, docking and dining at local establishments, and learning to sail from the captain.
